surprises.head: Seattle couldn’t get good looks
surprises.body: Seattle’s shots at 5-on-5 had a 3.0% chance of scoring on the average shot, against their usual 6.5% and a league average of 6.3%. A team strays this far less than once in a thousand games. You may never see it again.

story.head: Still no win for the Flyers
paras: Bobby McMann got the scoring started for the Kraken on the power play midway through the first. Dan Vladař stopped Jordan Eberle on a penalty shot early in the second. Ville Ottavainen, in his fifth NHL game, scored his first NHL goal, set up by Mackie Samoskevich, midway through the period to make it 2-0 for the Kraken. Christian Dvorak and Trevor Zegras scored a little over a minute apart early in the third to tie it 2-2. The shootout went five rounds, and McMann won it for the Kraken after Matty Beniers had scored earlier.

The Flyers had a little more of the play, but the Kraken made their chances count. Philipp Grubauer made 24 saves for the Kraken. The Kraken moved to 5-2-0. The Flyers are still looking for their first win of the season, now 0-5-3.

items.text: Three straight wins for the Kraken.
Trevor Zegras scored his first goal of the season, his first since Apr 13.
One of the preview’s two calls held.
